sources.section: cfg (the inline preset and its exportParameters)
sources.facts: Five maps: BaseColor RGB from documentMap basecolor; Roughness, Metallic and Height L from documentMap roughness, metallic and height; Normal RGB from virtualMap Normal_OpenGL. Parameters png, bitDepth 16, paddingAlgorithm infinite, dithering false; sizeLog2 set per recipe.
The hat v8 variant adds SpecularWeight (documentMap specularweight, L); it is not part of this preset (08-export.md §4: a later package).

sources.section: Full json_config dict possibilities; Export path wildcards
sources.facts: The preset form {name, maps[].{fileName, channels[].{destChannel, srcChannel, srcMapType, srcMapName}, parameters}}; the documentMap and virtualMap names used here; the $textureSet and $colorSpace wildcards and ( ... ) optional groups.

packing.decision: RGB from documentMap basecolor; png 16, infinite padding, no dithering
L from documentMap roughness; png 16, infinite padding, no dithering
L from documentMap metallic; png 16, infinite padding, no dithering
L from documentMap height; png 16, infinite padding, no dithering
RGB from virtualMap Normal_OpenGL (the combined normal); png 16, infinite padding, no dithering

Files are named $textureSet_<map>, where the script writes one caller-given prefix for every texture set; sizeLog2 is left to the texture set's size, where the script sets it per recipe through exportParameters. A caller that needs the script's fixed prefix or size keeps passing them inline.
